questions.text: What is Aizhan's mother's job?
questions.hint: "My mother is a doctor at the city hospital in Aktobe."

questions.text: How old is Aizhan's father Marat?
questions.hint: "My father is 47 years old and he is an engineer."

questions.text: Arman, Aizhan's brother, studies Computer Science.
questions.hint: "He studies Computer Science — the same subject I love!"

questions.text: Where do Aizhan's grandparents live?
questions.hint: "They live in a small village near Aktobe."

questions.text: Aizhan's sister Dana loves ___ and painting.
questions.hint: "Dana loves drawing and painting. Her room is full of her beautiful pictures."

questions.text: What is Aizhan's father's favourite hobby?
questions.hint: "His favourite hobby is fishing — he goes to the river every weekend."

questions.text: Aizhan's family has a tradition of eating dinner together every Friday.
questions.hint: "Every Friday evening, we have dinner together and talk about our week."

questions.text: How many siblings does Aizhan have?
questions.hint: "I have one brother and one sister." — two siblings total.

questions.text: What food does the family eat during the Friday video call?
questions.hint: "It's beshbarmak — your favourite! I made it especially for you."

questions.text: Aizhan's father asks about her new friends at university.
questions.hint: "How are your studies going? Are your professors good?" — he asks about studies, not friends.

questions.text: What does Arman advise Aizhan to join at WKU?
questions.hint: "Join the coding club. It helped me a lot!"

questions.text: Dana drew a picture of their whole ___.
questions.hint: "I drew our whole family!" — Dana.

questions.text: Aizhan says the food in the dormitory cafeteria is terrible.
questions.hint: "The dormitory cafeteria has good food." — Aizhan.

questions.text: Who asks Aizhan if she is eating well?
questions.hint: "How is your food in Uralsk? Are you eating well?" — Mum.

questions.text: My sister ___ a beautiful room full of paintings.
questions.hint: My sister = She → has. He/She/It always takes "has".

questions.text: "He don't have a sister" is correct English.
questions.hint: He → He doesn't have a sister. Use "doesn't have", never "don't has".

questions.text: ___ your parents have a garden at home? (question)
questions.hint: Parents = They → Do your parents have...?

questions.text: Which sentence is correct?
opts: My mother don't have a job.
questions.hint: He → doesn't have. The others all have errors.

questions.text: This is Aizhan. ___ family lives in Aktobe.
questions.hint: Aizhan = she → her family.

questions.text: Arman and Dana are siblings. ___ hobbies are different.
questions.hint: Arman and Dana = they → their hobbies.

questions.text: I love ___ grandmother's cooking. (I am talking about my own grandmother)
questions.hint: I → my grandmother.

questions.text: Which sentence correctly uses a possessive adjective?
opts: We is proud of our family.
questions.hint: She → her brother. The others have grammar mistakes.

questions.text: What does "caring" mean?
opts: kind and wanting to help others
questions.correct: kind and wanting to help others
questions.hint: Caring = kind and wanting to look after and help people.

questions.text: My grandparents are ___. They stopped working and now relax at home.
questions.hint: Retired = having stopped working because of age.

questions.text: What does "siblings" mean?
questions.hint: Siblings = your brothers and sisters.

questions.text: "Miss" means to find someone you were looking for.
questions.hint: "Miss" = to feel sad because someone you love is not with you. "I miss my family."

questions.text: What is a "role model"?
opts: a person you admire and want to be like
questions.correct: a person you admire and want to be like
questions.hint: "My brother Arman is my role model." — someone you look up to.

questions.text: My family is my ___. They make me want to study hard every day.
questions.hint: Motivation = a reason or desire to do something. "My family is my motivation."

questions.text: What does "tradition" mean?
opts: a custom passed down through generations
questions.correct: a custom passed down through generations
questions.hint: "Our family tradition is Friday dinner." — a regular, meaningful custom.

questions.text: What does "energetic" describe?
opts: someone who has a lot of energy
questions.correct: someone who has a lot of energy
questions.hint: "Dana is small, energetic, and very creative." — full of life and energy.
